Article Title: Mexico car bomb attack: Six injured in blast outside police station
Article Text:
A car bomb exploded outside a police station in Mexico's Zacatecas state on Sunday night, injuring six civilians and damaging the station and nearby properties, authorities said.

A car bomb exploded outside a police station in Mexico's Zacatecas state on Sunday night, injuring six civilians and damaging the station and nearby properties, authorities said.The blast took place in the town of Ojocaliente, where an explosive device had been placed inside a private vehicle."The explosive was placed in a private vehicle and caused physical damage to the station and properties located nearby," Zacatecas state government secretary Rodrigo Reyes said on Facebook.In a separate post, Reyes said, "Six civilians have been reported wounded, who are receiving medical care."Zacatecas is a key route in Mexico's drug trade, serving as a corridor for the smuggling of cocaine and other narcotics towards the United States. The state also connects central Mexico with the country's northern and western regions.The state has faced years of severe drug-related violence, including killings, disappearances and bodies being found in public places.In July, five people were found hanging from a bridge in the community of Pozos de Gamboa, about 75 kilometres from Ojocaliente. The victims included a former mayor, state employees and businesspeople from other parts of Zacatecas.Authorities have not yet identified those responsible for Sunday's bombing or disclosed a possible motive.
Article Summary: The blast took place in the town of Ojocaliente, where an explosive device had been placed inside a private vehicle. Zacatecas is a key route in Mexico's drug trade, serving as a corridor for the smuggling of cocaine. The state has faced years of severe drug-related violence, including killings, disappearances and bodies being found in public places.

Article Title: Raksha Bandhan reunion ends in tragedy as truck kills 2 sisters in UP
Article Text:
The force of the collision threw Nisha and Aashi onto the road, leaving them dead on the spot.





KANPUR: What began as a journey home after Raksha Bandhan ended in tragedy for a Madhya Pradesh family in Etawah on Sunday, when a speeding truck ploughed into their motorcycle near Bilampur turn under the Ekdil police station limits, killing two sisters and injuring three others, including a six-month-old infant.The victims, Nisha Kumari (26) and her younger sister Aashi (19), died on the spot in the crash. The injured were their brother Ayush Goyal, Nisha’s husband Neeraj Goyal (28), and her infant son Shivansh.Nisha and her family were on their way to the railway station to catch a train to Gwalior after celebrating Raksha Bandhan with Ayush when the accident occurred. From Gwalior, they were scheduled to travel to their home in Bhind.According to police, Neeraj was riding the motorcycle with four pillion passengers, in violation of traffic rules, when a speeding truck struck the two-wheeler on the highway. The force of the collision threw Nisha and Aashi onto the road, leaving them dead on the spot. The truck driver abandoned the vehicle and fled after the accident.Police teams rushed to the scene after receiving information about the crash and shifted the injured to a nearby hospital for treatment.While Ayush and Neeraj are undergoing treatment and are reported to be out of danger, Shivansh was discharged after being administered primary treatment.Etawah SSP Brijesh Kumar Srivastava said the bodies had been sent for postmortem examination and efforts were underway to trace and arrest the absconding truck driver.
Article Summary: Nisha Kumari (26) and her younger sister Aashi (19) died on the spot in the crash. The injured were their brother Ayush Goyal, Nisha’s husband Neeraj Goyal and her infant son Shivansh. The truck driver abandoned the vehicle and fled after the accident.

Article Title: Islam is 'greater' than other religions: Karnataka higher education minister Basavaraj Rayareddi
Article Text:
Karnataka minister Basavaraj Rayareddi (L) stated Islam is a great religion. BJP leader R Ashoka (R) demanded Rayareddi withdraw his statements and apologize.





BENGALURU: Karnataka higher education minister Basavaraj Rayareddi on Sunday said Islam is "greater" than other religions, news agency PTI reported.He expressed his desire to visit Mecca, but said he cannot do so as a non-Muslim.The minister made the remarks while speaking at a mass marriage programme for the Muslim community in Kuknoor in Koppal district.According to PTI, Rayareddi said, "I would like to say that Islam is shreshta dharam (great religion) than other dharmas...."He said there are misconceptions about the religion and added that he had tried to study the Quran, other religions and their history.Later, describing Islam as highly disciplined, highly scientific and the most humane religion, he said, "Read it, understand, and don't become bigots, don't become casteists. There are good and bad people in all religions, but bad things are always highlighted... We should respect all religions, we should know good things in all religions as religions are for well being of mankind and we should try to do good.""Islam is a good religion. I'm speaking here very happily. I'm thinking very much about going to Mecca, but I can't go there as one should convert to Islam (to go there). It's a tradition in that religion," he said."Islam is a good religion, there are good teachings in it, you should follow it, instead of just going to Masjid...," he added.His remarks drew a sharp reaction from BJP leader R Ashoka, who said that by stating, in effect, that "Islam is greater than other religions," Rayareddi had portrayed Sanatana Dharma in an inferior light.Ashoka, the leader of the opposition in the Assembly, demanded that Rayareddi withdraw his statements and apologise to all Hindus in the state.He also said that if Rayareddi refused, chief minister DK Shivakumar should demonstrate his commitment by removing him from the Cabinet."CM Shivakumar, is there no end to the anti-Hindu mindset of your Congress government? You go around visiting temples and putting on a display of devotion before cameras, but why do you remain silent when ministers in your own Cabinet make derogatory statements about Sanatana Hindu Dharma and temples," he asked.Ashoka further said, "... by stating, in effect, that Islam is greater than other religions, he has portrayed Sanatana Dharma in an inferior light."Questioning whether this was the Congress party's idea of "equal respect for all religions", Ashoka asked, "Is this your vision of a garden of peace for all communities? Or are all your theatrics and pretence merely another mask worn to secure Hindu votes?He said that if Rayareddi did not apologise or was not removed from the ministry, crores of Hindus in Karnataka would be left with one conclusion: "Your (CM) temple visits are not out of devotion. Your words are not out of respect for Hindu Dharma. Everything is merely for votes and for show."He further accused the Congress of being "Anti-Hindu".(With inputs from PTI)
Article Summary: Karnataka higher education minister Basavaraj Rayareddi said Islam is "greater" than other religions. He expressed his desire to visit Mecca, but said he cannot do so as a non-Muslim. He made the remarks while speaking at a mass marriage programme for the Muslim community.

Article Title: Noida horror: 5-year-old dies after father allegedly punches him during argument with wife
Article Text:
5-year-old dies after father allegedly punches him during wife row (AI image used for representational purpose only)





NOIDA: A man was detained on Sunday, a day after he allegedly killed his five-year-old son in Mamura area of Sector 66.An FIR was lodged on Saturday against Vikash Kumar (30), who is being questioned. Akash was declared dead at a hospital after the accused punched him in anger during an argument with his estranged wife on the same day.Phase 3 police station SHO Subhash Chandra said that around 5.30pm, Puja called Dial 112 and told police that her husband killed his son.The SHO said, “The FIR has been registered against Vikash under Section 105 (culpable homicide not amounting to murder) on the basis of the complaint lodged by child’s mother.”Vikash, a resident of Mamura in Sector 66, works in the cleaning department of a private company, police said. The husband and wife, who had seven children, live separately.On Saturday, Vikash reached his wife’s room located in Sector 66. During this time, a dispute broke out over some issue. In anger, Vikash beat up his fifth child. At that moment, he punched Akash hard on the back.“After being hit, the child fell to the ground and became unconscious. The mother immediately took him to the hospital, but doctors declared the child dead,” he said, adding that, based on the autopsy report, the cause of death and other facts related to the incident will be confirmed.
Article Summary: An FIR was lodged on Saturday against Vikash Kumar (30), who is being questioned. Akash was declared dead at a hospital after the accused punched him in anger during an argument with his estranged wife on the same day. The husband and wife, who had seven children, live separately.

Article Title: ‘Thank you CM Yogi, now please catch other accused’: Ankit Baliyan’s parents after 2 shooters killed in encounter
Article Text:
The encounter followed a strict district-wide vehicle checking and containment operation launched after the singer’s murder.

(With agency inputs)





SHAMLI: Satbir Baliyan, father of Haryanvi singer and actor Ankit Baliyan, on Monday thanked Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath and the police after two prime shooters allegedly linked to his son’s murder were killed in an encounter in Shamli.“I thank CM Yogi and the police...what we want is that this gang must be uprooted,” he said.“CM Yogi, I beg of you with folded hands. You have caught the two men involved. Now, please catch the others who are still at large and, above all, catch the mastermind who orchestrated the whole thing. He was the one pulling the strings,” Ankit Baliyan’s mother, Amaresh Baliyan, told news agency ANI.The encounter followed a strict district-wide vehicle checking and containment operation launched after the singer’s murder.Police teams were conducting midnight checkpoint checks when the fleeing suspects were allegedly intercepted and trappedShamli SP Narendra Pratap Singh explained how police were mobilised rapidly to track down the armed perpetrators.He said, "Our SWAT team, surveillance unit, and all SHOs, the ASP, and the COs (City and Kairana) were assigned to the case."Describing the execution of the district-wide security dragnet, Shamli SP Narendra Pratap Singh stated, "I had ordered the implementation of a blockade plan from midnight to 6.00 AM to ensure no vehicle could enter the district without being checked.Today, around 4.00 AM, while SHO Virendra Kasana of Hijana was conducting checks near his station, he spotted a motorcycle approaching from the direction of Karnal. He attempted to stop it. Two criminals were riding the bike; they immediately opened fire at him. He had a narrow escape, although his vehicle was hit by a bullet. He immediately sent a message over the wireless. The suspects' vehicle sped away and turned towards Kairana. When they reached beneath the Manna Madra bridge, SHO."Shamli SP Narendra Pratap Singh recounted how the fleeing suspects breached subsequent checkpoints before being cornered."Dharmendra Gautam of the Kotwali station was conducting checks. He tried to stop them, but they fired at him, shattering the vehicle's windshield. He immediately challenged them. The suspects turned left towards the city; however, since an alert had already been broadcast over the wireless, our SWAT team, surveillance in-charge, SHOs, CO City, ASP, and CO Kairana all arrived at the scene. Subsequently, the suspects suddenly swerved their vehicle to the right, towards this area," Narendra Pratap Singh said.Speaking to ANI, ADG Law and Order (Uttar Pradesh) Amitabh Yash further detailed the ongoing police operation and the recovery of illicit firearms from the individuals."Ankit Baliyan was murdered near the Shamli Kotwali. Analysis of CCTV footage and inquiries with locals revealed that four shooters were involved in the incident; they fled on two motorcycles. They were continuously pursued. This morning, two of the shooters, Sumit and Mohit, were killed in an encounter with the Shamli Police. Sophisticated weapons were recovered from them."Explaining how the suspects confronted the authorities, Amitabh Yash said, "They opened heavy fire on the police, injuring two of our constables. Investigations are currently underway regarding the other shooters and senior members of the gang; all of them will be brought to justice."Meanwhile, Uttar Pradesh deputy chief minister Brajesh Pathak said the killers of renowned singer Ankit Baliyan had been gunned down by police in an encounter."The ruthless killers of the renowned singer Ankit Baliyan have been gunned down by the police in an encounter today. The police will give a befitting response to anyone who attacks them. The state's law and order situation is excellent today, precisely because the morale of criminals has been completely shattered. No one is permitted to take the law into their own hands. The entire state was deeply saddened by the brutal manner in which Ankit Baliyan was murdered; today, the killers have paid the price for their actions, " Pathak said.Pathak said no one would be allowed to take the law into their own hands and added that the state had been deeply saddened by the “brutal” murder of Baliyan.He said the accused had now “paid the price for their actions”.
Article Summary: Satbir Baliyan thanks Uttar Pradesh chief minister Yogi Adityanath and the police after two prime shooters allegedly linked to his son's murder were killed in an encounter in Shamli. The encounter followed a strict district-wide vehicle checking and containment operation launched after the singer’s murder.

Article Title: 'Women should stay confined to homes': Kerala Islamic scholar Kanthapuram defends purdah remark
Article Text:
Islamic scholar Kanthapuram A P Aboobacker Musliyar stated women should remain confined to their homes.

(With PTI inputs)





KOCHI: Islamic scholar Kanthapuram A P Aboobacker Musliyar on Sunday said women should remain confined to their homes, days after a controversial circular issued by the Kanthapuram faction of the Samastha Kerala Jamiyyathul Ulama said women should not share public platforms with men.Speaking at an Islamic conference in Kochi, Kanthapuram defended the position, saying Islam had prescribed purdah for women to prevent what he described as “great destruction” caused by their presence on public platforms.“It is precisely recognising that bringing women onto public platforms in this manner causes great destruction that Islam mandated purdah for women. The Holy Quran states that women should live confined within their homes and must not make public appearances,” he said.The remarks came after the Samastha Kerala Jamiyyathul Ulama, the state's prominent council of Sunni-Shafi Islamic scholars, issued a circular last week stating that religious celebrations and programmes should remain within prescribed boundaries.In the circular, Samastha president E Sulaiman Musliyar and general secretary Kanthapuram directed that women should not share stages with men or appear in public spaces alongside them.The circular drew criticism from several quarters, including women political leaders who questioned the directive.Defending the stand, Kanthapuram said such views had been taught by religious scholars, particularly Samastha leaders, for around 100 years.“Therefore, you must understand that it is because all knowledgeable people, especially the leaders of Samastha, taught this here for 100 years that the women in this country have maintained their honour and dignity,” he said.Kanthapuram also said religious scholars who had studied Islam had an obligation to speak on the issue despite criticism.“When this is said, if leaders of any other organisation or Samastha leaders object to or question it, we have studied the religion and therefore have an obligation to say it. We will say it and continue to say it. No one can make us stop,” he said.
Article Summary: Islamic scholar Kanthapuram A P Aboobacker Musliyar on Sunday said women should remain confined to their homes. His remarks came after a controversial circular issued by the Samastha Kerala Jamiyyathul Ulama. The circular said women shouldn't share public platforms with men.

Article Title: Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan murder: 2 Gogi gang sharpshooters gunned down in Shamli encounter
Article Text:
Two suspected killers of singer Ankit Baliyan died in a police encounter early Monday morning





SHAMLI: Two sharpshooters involved in the murder of popular Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan were gunned down in a police encounter in the industrial area here on Monday morning. The slain accused, identified as Sumit and Mohit, were carrying rewards of Rs 50,000 each. Police said both belonged to the Gogi gang and were residents of Sonipat.According to officials, the duo had fled towards Loni via Baghpat after Baliyan’s murder. On Monday morning, while trying to reach Sonipat through the industrial area, they were surrounded by a police team. The criminals opened fire on the police party, forcing the cops to retaliate. Both accused were injured in the exchange and later declared dead at the hospital. Two policemen were also injured in the firing.SP Narendra Pratap Singh confirmed that the deceased were part of the gang that murdered Ankit Baliyan. Weapons and other incriminating material were recovered from the spot. Officials said more than 20 bullets hit the two accused during the encounter.Police investigations have revealed that four shooters were involved in the murder. With Sumit and Mohit neutralised, teams have intensified the hunt for the remaining two — Satyam and Aryan — and are conducting raids at their possible hideouts.Following Baliyan’s killing, police had analysed CCTV footage and other evidence to track the shooters. Intelligence inputs indicated their movement towards Baghpat and Loni, after which surveillance was stepped up on likely escape routes. The encounter took place during this intensified search operation early on Monday.
Article Summary: Two sharpshooters involved in the murder of popular Haryanvi singer Ankit Baliyan were gunned down in a police encounter in the industrial area here on Monday morning. The slain accused, identified as Sumit and Mohit, were carrying rewards of Rs 50,000 each.

Article Title: 8-year-old run over by SUV in Mumbai, dies; nutritionist held
Article Text:
An eight-year-old boy died after an SUV struck him while crossing a Bandra road. The motorist, Megha Rawal, was arrested and charged with culpable homicide.





MUMBAI: An eight-year-old boy crossing a road was killed after being run over by an SUV in Bandra (W) on Sund­ay afternoon. Police arrested the motorist, Megha Rawal, a 45-year-old nutritionist, and registered an FIR under BNS for ‘culpable homicide not amounting to murder’ besides the Motor Vehicles Act for ‘dangerous driving. ’Police said the mishap occurred at St John Baptist Road near Jijamata Garden when Ansh Gupta, a class 3 student from nearby Kadeshwari area, was returning home after playing in a garden. He was trying to cross the road when he was hit by the SUV around 2.15-2.30 pm, police said.Bystanders raised an alarm, after which Rawal, who hails from a business family, halted the vehicle a little ahead. An auto driver then lifted the child into the SUV. Rawal then took the child to Holy Family Hospital where he succumbed around 3.45 pm.Police were informed and she was taken into custody. Gupta’s parents were informed of the crash. The child’s body will be sent for a post-mortem examination. Experts from RTO will be called by Bandra police to examine the SUV and to determine the exact cause of the crash.In a separate crash earlier this year, a four-year-old boy died after an SUV rammed into him in the basement of his housing society in Malad (E).Laksh Singh, the victim, was the only child of his parents and was playing in the basement with friends. Police said the accused walked away without taking him to a doctor. It was also learnt that the accused had been warned by Singh's family in the past against rash driving inside the society compound, but to no avail.
Article Summary: Ansh Gupta, a class 3 student from nearby Kadeshwari area, was returning home after playing in a garden. Police arrested the motorist, Megha Rawal, a 45-year- old nutritionist, and registered an FIR under BNS for 'culpable homicide not amounting to murder'

Article Title: Fight over AI image ends in gunfire: Kolkata goon shoots brother-in-law at point-blank range
Article Text:
Santosh Chawdhary (L) was critically injured at PK Tagore Ghat by Khargosh alias Amit Sonkar





KOLKATA: Khargosh alias Amit Sonkar, who shot into the news for attempted extortion in central Kolkata ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha polls, is on the police radar again.This time, he allegedly targeted his 32-year-old brother-in-law, Santosh Chawdhary, a driver-turned-transporter, shooting and critically injuring him near PK Tagore Ghat on Strand Bank Road early Sunday. Police have termed the incident a “personal revenge”.The shooting occurred at 12.05 am, when Chawdhary, a resident of Sujendra Seth Lane in Jorabagan, was confronted by a group allegedly led by Khargosh, a known criminal from Jorabagan and Howrah who has been arrested multiple times on extortion charges.Eyewitnesses said Sonkar opened fire at point-blank range before fleeing with his accomplices.Chawdhary suffered severe bullet injuries and was rushed to Medical College & Hospital. He is critical.Family members said the shooting followed a bitter domestic dispute. Sonkar’s estranged wife had reportedly left him and moved to her parental home, allegedly unable to bear regular domestic abuse. Chawdhary and Sonkar’s wife are sisters.The victim’s family alleged that Sonkar subsequently created and leaked AI-doctored obscene photographs of female family members, including his estranged wife and Chawdhary’s wife.Despite complaints at Jorabagan PS and cop notices, the dispute continued.Following a complaint by Akash Chawdhary, North Port Police registered a case under BNS Sections 109(1) and 54, besides Sections 25(1B)(a) and 27 of the Arms Act, police said.Sonkar remains absconding as police conduct raids in Howrah and Jorabagan.
Article Summary: Khargosh alias Amit Sonkar shot into the news for attempted extortion in central Kolkata ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha polls. This time, he allegedly targeted his 32-year-old brother-in-law, Santosh Chawdhary, shooting and critically injuring him near PK Tagore Ghat. Police have termed the incident a “personal revenge”

Article Title: 3-year-old tied to chair, kicked and sexually assaulted at Delhi playschool
Article Text:
The father told police that he took the child to an ENT specialist on Aug 18 after noticing his distress (AI Image)

playschool assault case

His ears were being pulled and he was being hit, says father of kid 'assaulted' at playschool





NEW DELHI: A three-and-a-half-year-old boy was allegedly physically and sexually assaulted and mentally harassed at a private playschool in northeast Delhi's Maujpur, with CCTV footage purportedly showing him being tied to a chair, kicked and held by his ears.Police have registered a case invoking sections of Pocso Act and others under BNS against the school director, principal, teacher and a caretaker, with the latter arrested.The Directorate of Education (DoE) has also ordered an inquiry.According to the FIR, the child's father approached police after noticing a change in his behaviour.The complaint states that the boy had been unable to sleep properly for several days, was terrified of going to the toilet and would "cry inconsolably" at the prospect of going to school.The father told police that he took the child to an ENT specialist on Aug 18 after noticing his distress. The doctor, according to the complaint, noted swelling in the child's eardrums and suspected that he may have been physically abused.The family approached the school management and sought CCTV footage. The FIR alleges that the management initially claimed that the CCTV system was not functioning and later demanded Rs 1,500 for access to the footage.After obtaining the recordings, the father found footage of his son being assaulted inside the classroom. "His ears were being pulled and he was being hit," the complaint states. It further alleges that the child was tied to a chair for hours and kicked off the chair, causing him to fall. The footage also allegedly showed his food being taken away before he could eat.The complaint also contains an allegation of inappropriate touching involving the child, which is being investigated under the Pocso Act.According to the FIR, a school official allegedly told him that "children get beaten like this every day" and asked him to do whatever he wanted. The child was taken to a hospital. The medico-legal case noted swelling on his left thigh and an abrasion near his left eye.Police are examining the CCTV footage and DVR as part of the investigation.The arrested attendant has been taken into custody. The case was registered at Jafrabad police station under sections 115 (voluntarily causing hurt), 126 (wrongful restraint) and 3(5) (common intention) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Sections 75 and 82 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act and Section 12 of the Pocso Act.A DoE official said, "A committee comprising the additional director of education/regional director of education (east) as chairman is being constituted by the DoE to inquire into the child abuse incident, strictly in accordance with the guidelines issued from time to time under the Pocso Act. An FIR has been registered on the complaint of the parents at Jafrabad police station. The inquiry report will be submitted within two days. "The school's owner, said, "An investigation is under way, and all relevant matters have been handed over to police. The caretaker and the teacher have been permanently removed from the school. We are fully cooperating with the police in the investigation." The school principal could not be reached for comment.
Article Summary: A three-and-a-half-year-old boy was allegedly physically and sexually assaulted and mentally harassed. CCTV footage purportedly shows him being tied to a chair, kicked and held by his ears. Police have registered a case invoking sections of Pocso Act and others under BNS against the school director, principal, teacher and a caretaker.
